remarks: SONO 2BR CONDO! Location, Location, Location! Modern One Level Living 2BR/ 1BR/ Balcony/ Washer-Dryer in unit/ 2 Parking Spaces! Great location Across from Sono Train station by Downtown SONO for charming shopping experience and Restaurant row. Close to Beautiful Norwalk Harbor with waterfront restaurants and boating fun. Condo has Open floorplan with Large Living room with glass slider door to a private balcony. Kitchen with Updated Cabinets and a trendy subway tile backsplash. Special dining area. Updated full bath with double linen closet! All Rooms have floors with Wood finish. Rare to find Full-size side by side washer /dryer in the unit. Great for INVESTORS. Flight of Steps from Entry to First Floor. Enjoy SONO!
